description.value: A family-run motel and RV park on Highway 97 in 100 Mile House, in the heart of BC's Cariboo region, recognized by Destination BC as a 'Very Clean, Good Economy & Valued Motel and Campground.' Accommodation ranges from standard and deluxe motel rooms to fully equipped kitchen units, with a year-round RV park offering full hook-ups operable in temperatures as low as -20°C. The property serves as a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the Cariboo Highway corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the motel's identity, address, and phone number. Room and RV park pages explicitly list 'Free Internet' and 'Laundry Facilities,' supporting those amenity values. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or cyclist-specific services appears anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM address lists 'Cariboo Highway' while website specifies 'South Cariboo Hwy 97' — minor wording difference, clearly the same location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel and RV park with a live website, confirmed contact details, and year-round availability on a major cycling corridor.

Laundry.detail: RV park page lists 'Laundry Facilities' as an on-site amenity
